# Candidate lines carry a check bracket that is validated afterwards:
#   [path..., target]  path squares must be '.', target in [.pnbrq]
#   {sq...}            all must be '.'
#   <target>           target in [pnbrq]
KN = [(1, 2), (2, 1), (-1, 2), (-2, 1), (1, -2), (2, -1), (-1, -2), (-2, -1)]
KG = [(a, b) for a in (-1, 0, 1) for b in (-1, 0, 1) if a or b]
ORTH = [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]
DIAG = [(1, 1), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (-1, -1)]


def step_rule(r, c, piece, deltas):
    f = sq(r, c)
    cons = {f: piece, EP: "."}
    cands = []
    for dr, dc in deltas:
        if on(r + dr, c + dc):
            t = sq(r + dr, c + dc)
            cons[t] = "."
            cands.append(("[", "]", [t], {f: ".", t: piece, EP: "-"}))
    multi(cons, cands)


def ray_rule(r, c, piece, dirs):
    f = sq(r, c)
    cons = {f: piece, EP: "."}
    cands = []
    for dr, dc in dirs:
        path = []
        k = 1
        while on(r + k * dr, c + k * dc):
            t = sq(r + k * dr, c + k * dc)
            cons[t] = "."
            cands.append(("[", "]", path + [t], {f: ".", t: ("g", f), EP: "-"}))
            path = path + [t]
            k += 1
    multi(cons, cands)


for r in range(8):
    for c in range(8):
        step_rule(r, c, "N", KN)
        step_rule(r, c, "K", KG)
        ray_rule(r, c, "[RQ]", ORTH)
        ray_rule(r, c, "[BQ]", DIAG)

# pawns
for r in range(1, 7):
    for c in range(8):
        f = sq(r, c)
        newp = "Q" if r == 1 else "P"
        t = sq(r - 1, c)
        cons = {f: "P", EP: ".", t: "."}
        cands = [("{", "}", [t], {f: ".", t: newp, EP: "-"})]
        if r == 6:
            t2 = sq(4, c)
            cons[t2] = "."
            cands.append(("{", "}", [t, t2], {f: ".", t2: "P", EP: str(c + 1)}))
        for dc in (-1, 1):
            if on(r - 1, c + dc):
                t = sq(r - 1, c + dc)
                cons[t] = "."
                cands.append(("<", ">", [t], {f: ".", t: newp, EP: "-"}))
        multi(cons, cands)
        if r == 3:
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                if on(3, c + dc):
                    multi({f: "P", sq(3, c + dc): "p", sq(2, c + dc): r"\\.", EP: str(c + dc + 1)},
                          [("", "", [], {f: ".", sq(3, c + dc): ".", sq(2, c + dc): "P", EP: "-"})])

# castling (temporary multi-king encoding, fixed up after the check filter)
e1, f1, g1, h1 = sq(7, 4), sq(7, 5), sq(7, 6), sq(7, 7)
a1, b1, c1, d1 = sq(7, 0), sq(7, 1), sq(7, 2), sq(7, 3)
multi({e1: "K", f1: r"\\.", g1: r"\\.", h1: "R", FLAG["K"]: "S", EP: "."},
      [("", "", [], {f1: "K", g1: "K", EP: "-"})])
multi({a1: "R", b1: r"\\.", c1: r"\\.", d1: r"\\.", e1: "K", FLAG["Q"]: "L", EP: "."},
      [("", "", [], {c1: "K", d1: "K", EP: "-"})])

# validate check brackets
rules.append([r"(?m)^:\\[(?!\\.*[.pnbrq]\\])[^\\]\\n]*\\].*\\n?", ""])
rules.append([r"(?m)^:\\{(?!\\.*\\})[^}\\n]*\\}.*\\n?", ""])
rules.append([r"(?m)^:<(?![pnbrq]>)[^>\\n]*>.*\\n?", ""])
rules.append([r"(?m)^:[\\[{<][^\\]}>\\n]*[\\]}>]", ":"])

'''
open('gen.py','w').write(src[:start]+new+src[end:])
